8.t: Game is in test mode for a moment immediately after power is turned on or when test switch is on. When test switch is returned to ‘‘OFF’’ the game goes into attract mode.

1. ROM TEST The ROM data are checked 4K bytes at a time, and then checked together over all. If there are irregularities, the screen will display, for example, ‘‘ROM 1”’ or the like, identifying the bad ROM by number. The test series will not proceed to the RAM test. When there are no irregularties, ‘ROM OK”’ will be displayed and the RAM test will then be performed. The character ROM is not checked.
The position of the ROMs on the PCB as given by the ROM test message

2. RAM TEST Each of the 12 ICCs numbered 2114 are checked and when any irregularity is found a message (e.g. RAM 1L) is displayed and the test series stops. If there are no irregularities tests of game sounds and switches can begin. The RAM test is performed only on ICCs numbered 2114
Position of RAMs on PCB as given by test message
